title-group.article-title: An invented enhancer mutation changes reporter activity

abstract.p: We describe invented reporter experiments on the enhancer mutation T908G (chr2:60,490,908 T>G) for software tests.

sec.title: Reporter assays
sec.p: In a luciferase reporter in K562 cells, the T908G construct carrying the G allele gave twofold lower activity than the construct carrying the T allele.
The enhancer was active in K562 cells and inactive in HepG2 cells.

sec.title: Discussion
sec.p: Our invented results suggest that T908G lowers enhancer activity.
